parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region ID. You can call the DescribeRegions operation to query the most recent region list.

parameters.name: ResourceType
parameters.description: The type of the resource. Set the value to **INSTANCE**.

sub_parameters.name: Key
sub_parameters.description: The key of the tag. You can create N tag keys at a time. Valid values of N: **1** to **20**. The value of this parameter cannot be an empty string.

sub_parameters.name: Value
sub_parameters.description: The value of the tag. You can create N tag values at a time. Valid values of N: **1** to **20**. The value of this parameter can be an empty string.
